verdict.rationale: Intel docs confirm an NPU is present as one of three on-chip AI engines and that official runtimes/SDKs (OpenVINO, oneDNN, PyTorch optimizations via oneAPI, DirectML, ONNX RT, WebNN) ship today for Core Ultra processors, satisfying the SDK/runtime half of the story. However, no evidence item states a published TOPS figure or specifies compute precision (e.g., INT8) for the 285K's NPU specifically, so the 'published TOPS figure with precision' requirement is unmet. missing for 10: explicit NPU TOPS number, stated precision (e.g., INT8/FP16) for the 285K, independent benchmark corroborating the NPU spec.
